Add a bit carry property to arithmetic_alu (status flag, like a CPU carry flag). ADDC computes A + B + carry. ADD, ADDC, SUB, SUBB all update carry with the unsigned carry/borrow out. Calc's signature stays as in the spec.
The same carry bit acts as borrow. SUBB computes A - B - carry. Borrow out = 1 when the unsigned subtraction needs a borrow.
initialize() sets operand_A = 0, operand_B = 0, alu_op = OP_SEL_B, alu_result = 0 (and carry = 0 in arithmetic_alu). new() calls initialize().
CPU.Reset() calls initialize() on l_alu and a_alu. It does not re-create the objects.
Codes 4'b1110 and 4'b1111 are invalid. Calc returns 0, sets alu_result = 0 in neither ALU, and prints an $error naming the code. No state changes.
display() prints one line: [<class>] op=<op.name()> A=<%0d> B=<%0d> result=<%0d> (arithmetic_alu adds  carry=<0/1>).
